artist.name: Lady Gabe
artist.tagline: Muralist & illustrator bringing bold colour to Cheltenham walls
artist.bio:
Lady Gabe is a Cheltenham-based muralist and illustrator whose work turns blank walls into bursts of colour and character. Her style blends bold linework with a warm, painterly palette — equal parts street art energy and storybook charm.
From large-scale exterior commissions to intimate studio illustration, she works across scale without losing the playful signature that makes a piece unmistakably hers. Her murals have become local landmarks, and her commissioned work reaches collectors well beyond the South West.

collections.name: Street Murals
collections.description: Large-scale exterior work across Cheltenham and the South West.
